legend: As Valeric and Valerko were watching one of the last Euro Championship games in a sports bar, they broke a mug. Of course, the guys paid for it but the barman said that he will let them watch football in his bar only if they help his son complete a programming task. The task goes like that.
Let's consider a set of functions of the following form:
Valeric and Valerko really want to watch the next Euro Championship game, so they asked you to help them.
input: The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of functions. Each of the following n lines contains two space-separated integer numbers ki, bi ( - 109 ≤ ki, bi ≤ 109) that determine the i-th function.
output: Print a single number — the number of angles that do not equal 180 degrees in the graph of the polyline that equals the sum of the given functions.

legend.ai: Valeric 和 Valerko 在一家体育酒吧观看欧洲锦标赛的最后几场比赛之一时，打碎了一个杯子。当然，两人赔偿了杯子的费用，但酒保说，只有他们帮助他的儿子完成一道编程题，他才会允许两人在他的酒吧里继续看足球。题目如下。
考虑如下形式的函数集合：
Valeric 和 Valerko 非常想观看下一场欧洲杯比赛，所以他们请你帮助他们。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5）——函数的数量。接下来的 n 行中，每行包含两个由空格分隔的整数 k_i、b_i（-10^9 ≤ k_i, b_i ≤ 10^9），它们确定第 i 个函数。

output.ai: 输出一个数——在表示所给函数之和的折线图像中，不等于 180 度的角的数量。
